links.outcome: AI dietary advice conformity to KDIGO 2024 guideline; missed contraindications
links.effect: Models overlooked contraindications (low-protein diet in severe hypoalbuminemia), neglected age-specific needs, and lacked real-time knowledge updates. Accuracy scores 6.875-7.25, not significantly different (p=0.715).
links.quote: The AI models share several common limitations: they might overlook contraindications (such as recommending a low-protein diet for patients with severe hypoalbuminemia), neglect age-specific needs, and lack real-time knowledge updates.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates three commercial LLMs (ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Gemini) generating dietary recommendations against clinical guidelines via expert evaluation, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
